title: Level Surfaces of a Three-Variable Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Describe the level surfaces of w = x^2 + y^2 + z^2 and compute the surface area of the level surface corresponding to c = 25.

steps.title: Identify Level Surface Equation
steps.explanation: For c > 0, this defines a sphere of radius r = sqrt(c) centered at the origin.

steps.title: Calculate Surface Area for c = 25
steps.explanation: Use standard formula for the surface area of a sphere of radius 5.
